workspace.text:

- Tue: 16:30-17:00

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

- Mon 09:00-10:00: Elena busy (Contract review + Recruiting call), David busy (Quarterly planning + Recruiting call).
- Tue 16:30-17:00: Elena busy (Hiring panel), David busy (Travel).
- Wed 12:30-13:00: Elena busy (Budget review), David busy (Litigation strategy).
- Wed 15:00-16:00: David busy entire time (Partner lunch 15:00-15:30, Busy 15:30-16:00).
- Thu 10:00-10:30: Elena busy (Hiring panel). David is free but Elena is not.
- Fri 11:00-12:00: Elena busy (Client dinner prep + 1:1), David busy (Training session + Litigation strategy).

None of Priya and Marcus's overlapping free windows align with both Elena and David being free. It appears there is no 30-minute slot next week when all four partners are available. How would you like to proceed?

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
